mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permission p LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = 'enable' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC
SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permission p LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} and p.status = 'enable' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_id FROM permission p LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.role_id = #{roleId} and p.status = 'enable' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT * FROM permission
permission_id like concat('%', #{permissionId}, '%')
and permission_name like concat('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
and permission_code like concat('%', #{permissionCode}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (permission_name, permission_code, type, parent_id, path, hidden, keep_alive, icon, component, sort_order, create_time, status) VALUES (#{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{path}, #{hidden}, #{keepAlive}, #{icon}, #{component}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE permission SET permission_name = #{permissionName}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, type = #{type}, parent_id = #{parentId}, path = #{path}, icon = #{icon}, hidden = #{hidden}, keep_alive = #{keepAlice}, component = #{component}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
